Rig Spec

Joint hierarchy

root
└─ pelvis              bob · sway · compression spring · lunge
   ├─ spine            yaw = aim + melee twist · pitch/roll springs
   │  ├─ neck
   │  ├─ shoulder.R → elbow.R → wrist.R → socket.R  [GUN]
   │  └─ shoulder.L → elbow.L → wrist.L → socket.L  [MELEE]
   ├─ hip.L → knee.L → ankle.L   2-bone IK
   └─ hip.R → knee.R → ankle.R   2-bone IK

Weapon module contract

{
  id, name, slot: 'gun' | 'melee',
  socketRot,        // how it sits in the fist
  build() → {
    model,          // +Z = primary axis
    muzzle | tip,   // named attach points
    eject, barrels, spike, glowMat  // optional hooks
  },
  profile           // gun: burst, interval, recoil, charge, spinup, kick
                    // melee: keyframes + impact, hitstop, trail window
}

Weight model

Gait runs at 0.42 Hz with a 60% stance. Each foot lifts fast, hangs, then accelerates into the floor. A footfall fires impulses into four springs: pelvis compression, spine pitch, arm dip and camera bump. Melee runs anticipation, a hold, the strike, then a hitstop of 70–130 ms at impact. Recoil kicks the spine back and the railgun shoves the pelvis.
